text:
nicole: Quick sync — planning a targeted cutover for the new API compatibility shim expiry and v2 endpoint rollout tomorrow 10:30 PT. Need quick confirmations: who owns the client SDK toggle, docs banner, and graceful fallback behavior if the shim is removed?

sam: I can own the SDK toggle. PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/612 — needs a review and a smoke test run on staging.

dmitri: I will take fallback policies (server side). Plan is: if model returns 404 for old route, route to v2 mapping with header X-Compat-Used. Also add metric compat.fallback.count.

anya: For canary: recommend enabling 10% traffic to v2 first, then 50% after 30m if no errors. Ops runbook updated here: https://go/redwood/runbooks/compat-cutover.

andrew: Heads-up — deploy bot will block if any latency p95 regression > 30ms vs baseline. I updated threshold in pipeline.

marie: Docs banner is on me. I'll land a lightweight banner that points to Migration Guide and a link to the SDK toggle docs. ETA 2h.

nicole: Awesome. Two outstanding asks: (1) sam please drop the demo snippet we should add to the banner (quick example toggling). (2) dmitri — confirm rollback knob exists and is testable from staging console.

sam: Demo snippet (inline):
```js
// enable v2 in client
import Redwood from 'redwood-inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiVersion: 'v2', featureFlags: { compatShim: false } });
await client.text.generate('hello');
```
Use in banner as "Try v2 with the SDK toggle".

dmitri: Rollback knob exists — console toggle + API header override. Verified on staging just now. I also added an alert if compat.fallback.count spikes > 5/min.

nicole: Great. Can someone call out any cross-team blockers? infra? security?

sam: infra gave a thumbs-up in the ticket but asked we prove the shim removal does not expose any extra endpoints. I will run a probe.

marie: Security asked for a short blurb about deprecation timeline to include in policy. I'll draft and share for review.

docs-bot: Reminder: please add migration note to changelog section "API compatibility" before cutover.

nicole: OK — final checklist:
- SDK PR merged (sam)
- Fallback + alerts in prod (dmitri)
- Docs banner + changelog (marie)
- Canary schedule + runbook (anya)
- Deploy thresholds set (andrew)
- Infra probe pass (sam)

If all green by 09:30 PT tomorrow I'll kick the cutover. React with :thumbsup: when you're good.

sam: :thumbsup:

dmitri: :thumbsup:

anya: :thumbsup:

andrew: :thumbsup:

marie: :thumbsup:

nicole: Thanks team. I'll post final go/no-go at 09:45 PT in #eng-releases and ping oncall if anything flakes.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: compat-cutover-2024-12-02-10-30-PT (ID: job-9982).
